$comment: Accepted npm audit findings with no upstream fix. Every entry needs ghsa, package, reason, expires (YYYY-MM-DD); scripts/npm-audit-check.mjs fails CI once an entry expires so it gets re-reviewed. See TESTING.md §7.

entries.reason: ICNS parser DoS. The only patched release is image-size 2.0.3; the 1.x line has none (latest 1.2.1 is in range). pptxgenjs 4.0.1, its latest release and our only dependent, requires image-size ^1.2.1, and npm audit fix --force proposes pptxgenjs 4.0.0, a downgrade that still depends on image-size ^1.1.1. pptxgenjs's dist never requires image-size (grep of node_modules/pptxgenjs/dist: 0 hits as of 2026-10-25; its Node path requires 'sizeof'), and pptxgenjs is bundled solely for the pptx skill.

JXL/HEIF parser DoS. The only patched release is image-size 2.0.3; the 1.x line has none (latest 1.2.1 is in range). pptxgenjs 4.0.1, its latest release and our only dependent, requires image-size ^1.2.1. The only dependent (pptxgenjs) never loads image-size.
